headline: Iran's IRGC Claims Gulf Attacks on US Radar and Commercial Vessels
summary: Iran's Revolutionary Guard reported launching drone strikes on a US radar facility in Bahrain and claimed an oil tanker and LPG carrier struck naval mines in the Strait of Hormuz.
why: The Strait of Hormuz is the world's most critical oil transit chokepoint, handling approximately 20% of global petroleum shipments.

impacts.name: Brent Crude
impacts.why: Disruptions and mine hazards in the Strait of Hormuz directly threaten crude oil shipping routes.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Reports of naval mine strikes on commercial tankers in the Strait of Hormuz raised supply disruption risks, pushing crude oil prices higher.
